title.narrative: Sindh Cities Improvement Investment Program - Tranche 2

description.narrative: The project focuses on priority infrastructure identified by North Sindh Urban Services Corporation Ltd (NSUSC) based on existing master plans and ongoing master planning exercise in Ghotki, Jacobabad, Khairpur, New Sukkur, Rohri, and Shikarpur.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President

description.narrative: Increased quality, reliability, and coverage of water supply, wastewater, and solid waste management services in participating towns

Water distribution network access increased from 37% in 2012 to 80% of the population by 2016 in Sukkur, New Sukkur, Rohri and Khairpur Progress/Status: Not achieved, since the related contracts could not be not awarded. Data Source: Project IPPMS Actual value:

Average hours per day of water supply increased from 4 hours in 2012 to over 10 hours for 65% of population by 2016 in Sukkur, New Sukkur, Rohri and Khairpur Progress/Status: Not achieved:
Average hours per day of water supply is around 4 hours in Rohri, and 2.1 hours in Khairpur. The actual hours of supply range from 0.5 hours to 12 hours in different locations. Data for Sukkur are not available. In the 5,596 houses in the DNI zones, water supply is provided for more than 10 hours per day, with 3,411 receiving portable water. Data Source: Baseline and follow-up surveys
Project IPPMS Actual value:

Population with household water connections increased to 65% by 2016 from 40% in 2012 at Sukkur, New Sukkur, Rohri and Khairpur Progress/Status: Not achieved, since the related contracts could not be not awarded. Data Source: Project data - IPPMS
Pakistan Standard of Living and Measurement Survey S-Cruve Actual value:

Household access to secondary SWM services increased on average from 65% in 2012 to 85% by 2016 at Sukkur, New Sukkur, Rohri and Khairpur Progress/Status: Accordingly to an assessment made in 2017, the collection percentage of solid waste ranges from 45% to 90% in various towns.
This will be reassessed during the PCR Mission. Data Source: Baseline and follow-up surveys
